Personas minted with `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user` + `change-password` (A, B, C). Step 6 (bindings) needed explicit permission sets because members hold no baseline grant on the scratch objects (every list 403 PERMISSION_DENIED before binding): authored `qa_att_reader` (read on the three scratch objects; read/create/edit/delete on sys_attachment; read sys_file) for A, `qa_att_baseline` (sys_attachment read/create/delete, sys_file read, nothing on the parents) for B, `qa_att_editor` (read/create/edit on the scratch objects + sys_attachment) for C via `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/NAME?package=…` and bound with `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set`. Independent split proof before any storage clause: A reads `qa_shared` 200 / edits 403, `qa_vault` record 404; B reads neither parent (403 PERMISSION_DENIED) but lists sys_attachment 200; C reads `qa_shared` 200, edit of an admin-owned row 403.

## Checklist-accuracy notes (closed out on the wave anchor, not extracted)

1. `download-authz-both-sides` step 7 / clause 4: persona B (no parent read) never reaches RecordAttachmentsPanel — the record page refuses first ("You don't have access to QA vault records"). The reachable shape is a panel opened while entitled, then the grant removed, then Download.
2. `sys-file-status-pipeline` step 8 vs step 9: a join row added over REST runs the un-tombstone hook, so the "still deleted after a 200" read in clause 2 can only come from a hook-bypassing system write or the unit pin.
3. `upload-session-abort` step 8: "an eTag list the backend rejects" no longer reaches the backend — the route answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the mismatched chunks and the row stays `in_progress`; `failed` is only reachable through the test seam.
4. `field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced` knownGaps WIRE-ENVELOPE + clause 2: measured 400 `ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT` with the prose in the body, not a sanitized 500 — revise per the clause's own instruction.
